description: Source code for a sandbox filesystem bridge implementation, providing methods for resolving paths, reading, writing, creating directories, removing, renaming, and statting files within a sandbox environment, with integration to backend shell commands and path safety checks.

classes.name: SandboxFsBridgeImpl
classes.description: Implementation of the SandboxFsBridge interface, providing filesystem operations within a sandbox environment with safety and backend command execution.

methods.name: createSandboxFsBridge
methods.description: Factory function to create a SandboxFsBridge instance for a given sandbox context.

methods.name: resolvePath
methods.description: Resolves a file path within the sandbox to a SandboxResolvedPath object.

methods.name: readFile
methods.description: Reads a file from the sandbox, returning its contents as a Buffer.

methods.name: writeFile
methods.description: Writes data to a file in the sandbox, creating directories if needed.

methods.name: mkdirp
methods.description: Creates a directory and any necessary parent directories.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a file or directory, with options for recursive and force removal.

methods.name: rename
methods.description: Renames a file or directory within the sandbox.

methods.name: stat
methods.description: Retrieves the status of a file, returning type, size, and modification time.

methods.name: runCommand
methods.description: Executes a shell command within the sandbox environment, either via backend or Docker.

methods.name: readPinnedFile
methods.description: Reads a file given a sandbox resolved path, opening and closing the file descriptor.

methods.name: runCheckedCommand
methods.description: Runs a command plan after asserting path safety checks.

methods.name: runPlannedCommand
methods.description: Runs a command plan with optional rechecking.

methods.name: ensureWriteAccess
methods.description: Checks if the sandbox workspace allows writes and if the target path is writable.

methods.name: resolveResolvedPath
methods.description: Resolves a file path considering sandbox mounts and current working directory.
